PaintFE 1.5.0 adds the requested plugin browser, Community add-ons, along with optional AI agent control and more ways to customise the interface. It also improves selection rotation, lines and toolbar rendering.

### New features

- Add Community add-ons for browsing and installing effect plugins, icon packs and themes made by users. Open it from View, with search, filters, Favourites and installed-pack management. Downloads are always requested by you; installed effects run offline.
- Create and share script effects with native controls, previews and Cancel. The first packs are Two Tone, Paper Grain, Colour Offset and Soft Vignette. Related to discussion 242.
- Preview themes and icon packs before keeping them, with an option to restore your previous appearance. Luminous remains the default icon family and Classic is still available.
- Expand appearance customisation to support transparent and glass-style custom themes. Adjust surface opacity, colours and borders, with optional native desktop blur. Glass Dark in charcoal and Glass Light in pearl white are included as starting points. Glass is off by default and does not affect your saved images.
- Connect compatible MCP clients to inspect previews, paint, work with selections and layers, undo changes and run permitted scripts. Connections, editing and scripts have separate permissions and are disabled by default. PaintFE does not include an AI model. Related to discussion 242.
- Add guides for installing and creating community packs, connecting an MCP client and customising glass appearance.

### Fixes and improvements

- Restore the default appearance fully with Reset to Signal, including turning glass off. Keep Light/Dark switches consistent across Preferences and View while retaining glass opacity, blur and layout choices.
- Keep add-on cards inside the browser window, with wrapping and vertical scrolling. Load the catalogue before artwork, prepare previews in the background and show progress while loading.
- Use the new favourite icons with colours that follow the theme.
- Improve advanced appearance controls so repeated colour rows no longer conflict with each other.
- Keep low toolbar and panel opacity settings working when glass tints are enabled.
- Improve 1 px dotted and dashed line spacing with antialiasing off, including diagonal lines. Related to issue 244.
- Keep selected pixels in one editable transform through repeated quarter turns, avoiding repeated cuts and preserving the original source until Apply. Related to issue 238.
- Show the image and grids beneath a translucent docked toolbar without shifting the canvas when changing tools. Related to issue 223.
- Improve small and rotated Square and Diamond tips so their cursors match what is painted. Related to issue 243.
- Improve Line handles, fast drawing, dotted and dashed spacing, temporary colour sampling and live setting changes. Finishing a numeric field no longer also commits or cancels the line. Related to issue 244.
- Remove unwanted dotted patterns from pale and transparent previews while keeping intentional dotted lines and editor overlays.
- Improve Linux font family and weight lookup, with unsupported font faces skipped safely. Related to issue 241.

Community add-ons and author guides: https://github.com/kylejckson/PaintFE_plugins

Documentation: https://paintfe.com/docs
